title: As Democrats Plow Into Red States, They Worry About Tight Races in Bluer Ones
summary: Despite hopes for a blue wave, Democratic candidates in Minnesota, Maine and Michigan are facing local political headwinds and have struggled to open up clear daylight in the polls.
